title: An invoice keeps its term and due date when the customer is moved
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a new term of the shop's own for this test, term A, due 20 days after the invoice date.
  • Create customer A for this test on term A, with invoice A dated Oct 5, 2026 (due Oct 25, 2026, Terms term A).
  • Make sure Net 60 is active.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the term A row.
  2. Click "Move Customers".
  3. Choose "Net 60" in "Move To".
  4. Click "Move 1 Customer".
  5. Open invoice A.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The menu opens.

Step 2:

  • The "Move Customers from term A" window opens with customer A ticked.

Step 3:

  • The dropdown shows Net 60.

Step 4:

  • The toast "1 customer moved to Net 60." shows.

Step 5:

  • Invoice A still shows Terms term A and Due date Oct 25, 2026 (Oct 5 + 20 days).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11676 (Story 7, Due dates)

  • S7-R7: “An invoice keeps the term and due date it was created with. Changing the customer's term later, deactivating the term or moving the customer never changes an existing invoice.”
